ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
From {H:1826216068000}, the Moon moves into {S:2} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The sextile between the Sun and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.
